methods: Five fixed comparable methods: inventory, m0, m1, m0_noI, m1_noI. Identical row law, FIT global unpenalized intercept (no per-beta intercept), linear plus elementwise quadratic columns standardized using FIT global moments. No products/interactions. Ridge on mean squared error with penalty alpha times squared slope norm; identical alpha candidates [1,.01,.0001], selected per method/target by equal-beta even-DEV absolute MSE; strongest on exact tie. Absolute errors in the signed rule units for all three targets f, central conventional projection, central residual (f minus projection); all normalized gains use the same frozen equal-beta Var_fit(f). Full FIT sufficient Gram matrices are accumulated by bounded parent block. Equal FIT anchor/parent weighting for variance includes cross-beta mean shifts; no mean of within-beta variances.
primary: Parent effect is average across eight paired squared-loss differences (m0-m1)/Var_fit(f); g=.01 is the fixed material threshold, not a fit parameter. Report each beta's absolute costs, opportunities, parent n, paired g, sample SD/SE, two-sided t95 intervals, and Bonferroni two-sided 95% family intervals over 8 nonzero eligible betas (index 0 negative control). Macro mean over all 8 nonzero indices equally weighted; fixed-stratum Welch SE sqrt(sum s_b^2/n_b)/B and t with Satterthwaite df; never drop a low-n beta. If any stratum has n<2, no macro interval/positive. Individual positive claims require simultaneous lower95>.01 AND successful primary global/residual/null decision. Residual macro lower95>0, FIT residual variance fraction >=.10. Distinct global parent lineage per committed routing and absence of release violations required.
support_null: Use exact (I_v,I_A) fit support >=8 distinct FIT parents across the admitted training population (not repeated anchors). Report coverage by beta at unchanged deployment rate; do not filter the endpoint. Require equal-beta mean supported fraction >=.90 on odd DEV and blind panel before hidden release. Beta-zero exact-I leakage null is twice the support-weighted within-cell covariance of f and (m1-m0), normalized by same FIT variance, excluding same-parent pairs; delete whole parents including eligibility and weights for t95 jackknife CI. Require >=.90 estimable opportunity fraction, and entire CI within [-.01,.01]. Also report actual beta-zero g and interval; a leakage equivalence statement is not acceptance of zero squared-loss difference.

Projected power for a true .02 over material margin .01 (identical .01 separation to test vs zero), using noncentral t with projected Welch df, upper tail of two-sided 95% CI.
